taxonomy.interpretation: Interacting outcome dimensions for engineering-system improvement; not four framework layers and not local acceptance gates.

conflicts.issue: Advanced automation and AI claims assume suitable data and capabilities. Automated analysis and24hour availability assertions do not establish correct or authorized results.
Central knowledge and integration coordination do not authorize merging function-owned repositories or replacing canonical control ownership.
Commented table rows are source editorial remnants; they cannot be converted to active policy through extraction alone.
Metrics and rapid interventions may distort developer behavior; source explicitly recommends controlled pilots and balanced outcome zones.
Maturity stages are contextual paths, not mandatory acquisition of AI, analytics or training services.
